note: 同一個拼法、在一般英文和護理裡意思不同的字（像 pupil：學生／瞳孔），以及護理單字裡容易搞混的字。護理單字遇到前一種，練習紀錄跟一般單字分開記。

nurseEx.en: Her pupils are equal and react to light.
nurseEx.zh: 她的兩邊瞳孔一樣大，對光有反應。

everydayEx.en: The teacher has thirty pupils.
everydayEx.zh: 這位老師有三十個學生。

nurseEx.en: His flu test is positive.

everydayEx.en: She always stays positive.

nurseEx.en: The COVID test came back negative.
nurseEx.zh: 新冠檢測的結果是陰性。

everydayEx.en: Try not to be so negative.

nurseEx.en: He needs admission to the hospital tonight.

everydayEx.en: Admission to the museum is free.

same.everyday: 排出、放出（字表也有「出院」）

nurseEx.en: There is yellow discharge from the wound.

everydayEx.en: The factory discharged dirty water into the river.

nurseEx.en: Put on a gown and gloves before you go in.
nurseEx.zh: 進去之前先穿隔離衣、戴手套。

everydayEx.en: She wore a long gown to the party.
everydayEx.zh: 她穿長禮服去參加派對。

nurseEx.en: Let's turn him onto his left side.

everydayEx.en: It's your turn.

nurseEx.en: Is there an order for pain medicine?

everydayEx.en: Can I take your order?

nurseEx.en: She is alert and oriented.
nurseEx.zh: 她意識清醒、定向感正常。

everydayEx.en: Stay alert when you drive at night.

nurseEx.en: We need a doctor's order to use restraints.

everydayEx.en: He showed great restraint.

nurseEx.en: The patient is in contact isolation.

everydayEx.en: Some older people live in isolation.
everydayEx.zh: 有些老人過著孤立的生活。

nurseEx.en: These are oral tablets. Swallow them with water.
nurseEx.zh: 這是口服藥錠，配水吞下去。

everydayEx.en: We have an oral test tomorrow.

nurseEx.en: New confusion in an older patient can be a sign of infection.
nurseEx.zh: 長者突然出現意識混亂，可能是感染的徵兆。

everydayEx.en: There was some confusion about the time.

nurseEx.en: Sudden weakness on one side of the body can be a stroke.
nurseEx.zh: 身體一側突然無力，可能是中風。

everydayEx.en: She stroked the cat.

nurseEx.en: Write it in the patient's chart.

everydayEx.en: Look at the chart on page 5.

nurseEx.en: I'll call the resident on duty.
nurseEx.zh: 我會打給值班的住院醫師。

everydayEx.en: The residents of this town are friendly.

nurseEx.en: He is in critical condition.

everydayEx.en: Don't be so critical of yourself.

nurseEx.en: Take one tablet twice a day.

everydayEx.en: I read e-books on my tablet.

nurseEx.en: I'll change your dressing now.

everydayEx.en: Do you want dressing on your salad?

nurseEx.en: The patient in Room 5 needs help.

everydayEx.en: Please be patient.

same.nurse: （細菌）培養：blood culture 血液培養

nurseEx.en: We took two sets of blood cultures.
nurseEx.zh: 我們抽了兩套血液培養。

everydayEx.en: I love learning about Japanese culture.

nurseEx.en: Are you allergic to contrast dye?

everydayEx.en: There is a big contrast between the two cities.
everydayEx.zh: 這兩個城市的差別很大。

same.nurse: 急救代碼（code blue：病人心跳或呼吸停止，啟動急救）

nurseEx.en: Call a code blue in Room 8!

everydayEx.en: Enter the code to open the door.

same.nurse: 負責（charge nurse：當班的負責護理師）

nurseEx.en: Ask the charge nurse about the beds.
nurseEx.zh: 床位的事去問當班負責護理師。

everydayEx.en: I need to charge my phone.

same.nurse: 說自己有（某個症狀）、主訴

nurseEx.en: He complains of chest pain.

everydayEx.en: She always complains about the food.

nurseEx.en: You need to be fasting for this blood test.

everydayEx.en: He runs very fast.

same.nurse: sharps：用過的針頭等尖銳物（sharps container 尖銳物收集筒）

nurseEx.en: Put the used needle in the sharps container.
nurseEx.zh: 用過的針頭丟進尖銳物收集筒。

everydayEx.en: Be careful, the knife is sharp.

confusable.tip: dementia 失智症：慢慢變差、持續很久；delirium 譫妄：突然出現，一天裡時好時壞，常找得到原因（感染、藥物、脫水），處理後可以改善。
heart attack 心肌梗塞：供應心臟的血管突然塞住；heart failure 心臟衰竭：心臟充盈或泵血功能異常，可造成喘、疲倦或水腫。心臟衰竭可急性發生或以慢性病程發展，射出分率也可保留。
intravenous 靜脈注射（IV）、intramuscular 肌肉注射（IM）、subcutaneous 皮下注射（SC／SubQ）：前面的字根說打到哪裡。
nausea 噁心（想吐）；vomiting 嘔吐（真的吐出來）。
numbness 麻木（摸起來沒感覺）；tingling 刺麻感（像針在刺）。
sodium 鈉（Na）；potassium 鉀（K）：兩個都是電解質，名字跟化學符號對不太起來，要分開記。
